instruction: For each movie title in column B, clean it by removing extra whitespace and applying title case. Then count the number of words in each cleaned title and write only the word count (as a number) to the corresponding row in column C.

metadata.explanation: Task requires counting words in each title. Examples: 'Minions In Black' -> 3, 'The Dragon With The Girl Tattoo' -> 6. Agent must write 28 numbers (word counts) to column C.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit: Score = (count of valid word count numbers) / 28. Full credit (1.0) if all 28 cells contain valid word counts (1-10).
